subject.title: marketplace-crons: TodoColeccion entra en rate limit en create y el circuit breaker corta el lote

question: Should TodoColeccion product throttling be solved by tuning create/backoff behavior inside the products scope, by further splitting create and updatePrice breaker/scheduling, or by treating the current abort as acceptable provider protection?
rationale: The source still has the protective abort, but the safe permanent fix depends on current production frequency and the provider’s real rate-limit semantics rather than a purely local code preference.

options.title: Tune products throttling first
options.body: Use fresh logs/provider evidence to add a narrow create-side backoff or budget while preserving the scoped breaker protection.

options.title: Split create and price isolation
options.body: Separate create and updatePrice breaker or cron behavior if current logs show one products subflow still starves the other.

options.title: Accept current protection
options.body: Leave the abort behavior in place if current production data shows the remaining rate limits are rare and safer than continuing the batch.

recommendation.title: Tune products throttling first
recommendation.body: Use fresh logs/provider evidence to add a narrow create-side backoff or budget while preserving the scoped breaker protection.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent TodoColeccion API and error-classification work makes this the strongest code-history owner for the rate-limit behavior.
